newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Light says Kadoorie's stake diluted.
newsitem.headline: China Light says Kadoorie's stake diluted.

text.p: China Light & Power Co Ltd said on Wednesday the Kadoorie family's stake in the utility company would decline to 26.6 percent from 33.3 percent after a HK$16.25 billion share placement to CITIC Pacific Ltd.
The Kadoorie family, China Light's controlling shareholder, would continue to hold 662.17 million China Light shares through various trusts.
Beneficiaries of these trusts include R.J. McAulay, A.J.K. McAulay and China Light chairman Michael Kadoorie, China Light said in statement.
China Light said although the Kadoorie family's interest had been diluted, it would remain a long-term shareholder and had no intention of selling any shares.
CITIC Pacific said on Tuesday it would acquire 497.66 million new China Light shares at HK$32.66 each, representing a 20 percent stake in China Light's enlarged share capital.
Trading in China Light shares was suspended on Tuesday and the company said it has made an application to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for trading to resume on Wednesday. ($1 = HK$7.8)
